title: How much traffic does a bad release touch?
description: Compare rollout strategies by changing release frequency, failure rate, first-wave exposure, and containment time. The model keeps workload demand fixed so the control-loop trade-off remains visible.

strategies.label: Rolling update
strategies.detail: Replace instances in batches while old and new versions serve together.
strategies.rollback: Reverse the rollout and wait for replacement instances to become ready.

strategies.label: Measured canary
strategies.detail: Hold a small representative cohort until service and business gates pass.
strategies.rollback: Route canary traffic to zero and preserve the failed revision for diagnosis.

strategies.label: Blue-green switch
strategies.detail: Prepare a parallel environment, validate it, then switch the production route.
strategies.rollback: Switch traffic back to the warm previous environment.
